sources.summary: Complete 3D-printable carriage, belt tensioner end blocks, and geared pan/tilt head built on dual 2020 V-slot rails.
keyTakeaways: Spacing two 2020 rails 60mm center-to-center creates a wide 80mm wheelbase that eliminates camera pitch nod with heavy telephoto lenses.
Use 7.2mm bores on one side of PRT-04 for 6mm eccentric spacers so Delrin V-wheels preload cleanly against the V-slot groove.

sources.summary: Firmware for synchronized 3-axis Bresenham/S-curve stepper interpolation, shoot-move-shoot bulb triggering, and two-point parallax tracking.
keyTakeaways: Configure TMC2209 in StealthChop2 mode (256 interpolated microsteps) so on-camera shotgun microphones pick up zero stepper hum.
Use an optocoupler on the 2.5mm TRS jack to trigger Sony/Canon/Nikon shutters during shoot-move-shoot intervals.
